title: Austin's Closed-Door Convention Center Talk
summary:
*   The meeting consisted entirely of a closed-door executive session.
*   Discussions included legal advice, land acquisition, litigation, and personnel matters.
*   A key specific item discussed was parking arrangements for the Convention Center.
*   No final policy decisions or actions were taken during this special meeting.
